page.title: Money
page.subtitle: Where your money came from and where it went
page.notStartedNoEdit: The books have not been started yet. Ask the owner to start them.

start.title: Start your books
start.what: From now on Balce writes down every sale, stock change and payment in your books by itself. You only add the money that goes out, like rent or salaries.
start.why: Then you can see your real profit, where your money is, and what you own and owe.
start.fromHistoryHelp: Balce uses the sales and stock you already have, starting {date}.
start.fromTodayHelp: Only what happens from today counts. Your stock today is the starting point.
start.moneyTitle: How much money do you have now?
start.moneyHelp: Optional. Leave empty if you are not sure; you can add it later with “Owner put in”.
start.confirmHistory: The books will start on {date} using your existing sales and stock.
start.confirmToday: The books will start today, {date}, with the stock you have now.
start.startedHelp: Every new sale and stock change goes into the books automatically.

catchUp.title: Some records are missing from the books
catchUp.help: {count} sales or stock changes happened while accounting was off.

cards.moneyInHint: Sales and other money that came in
cards.moneyOutHint: Expenses and money the owner took
cards.profitHint: Sales minus what the goods cost and your expenses

balances.title: Where the money is now

actions.ownerOutHelp: Money the owner took for personal use

descriptions.expense: Write down money you paid for the business.

descriptions.owner_out: Money the owner took for personal use. It is not an expense of the shop.
descriptions.money_move: Move money between cash, mobile money and the bank.
descriptions.other_income: Money that came in but not from selling, like rent you receive.

form.feeHelp: Optional. Bank or mobile money charges for this move.

entries.empty: Nothing recorded for this period yet

reverse.title: Reverse this record?
reverse.description: The record stays in the books and a new record cancels it out. Money balances go back to how they were.
reverse.reasonRequired: Write why you are reversing it

profit.title: Profit
profit.goodsCost: What the goods you sold cost

ownOwe.ownerHelp: What is left for the owner after paying everything owed

accountsPanel.title: Chart of accounts
accountsPanel.name: Name
accountsPanel.addDescription: Custom accounts can be turned off later. Turned-off accounts keep their history but take no new entries.

reports.checkSales: Sales in the books match the sales report
reports.checkSalesBad: Sales in the books differ from the sales report by {amount}
reports.checkStock: Stock in the books matches the stock value
reports.checkStockBad: Stock in the books differs from today's stock value by {amount}

manual.title: Manual entry
manual.description: For your accountant: debits must equal credits. A reason is required.

errors.lines: Each line needs an account and either a debit or a credit
errors.unbalanced: Debits and credits must be equal

close.title: Close the month
close.description: Once closed, nothing can be recorded or changed on or before this date. Closing can only move forward.
close.notYet: No month has been closed yet
